extracted.intended_audience: advertising and design professionals, in-house creatives, agency-side teams, solo creators, students and recent graduates
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluation priorities for submitting creative advertising and design work to the D&AD Awards (including the New Blood Awards for students and starters). Emphasises cultural impact, creative bravery, rigour, and career impact rather than technical entry rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative bravery / benchmark
rubrics_metrics.description: The benchmark for creative bravery — work that moves culture and challenges the creative industries to do better.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should demonstrate creative bravery: ideas that push boundaries, provoke thought, and have cultural relevance. The awards are positioned as a standard-setting benchmark rather than a participation prize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural impact / 'work that matters'
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that moves culture and is proof you've made something that matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should show meaningful impact beyond craft — how the work influences culture, conversations, or behaviour. The copy frames a Pencil as evidence of work that matters to peers and industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigour and integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: For professionals – the industry benchmark for commercial creativity, the D&AD Pencil stands for rigour and integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges value well-executed, honest, and professionally rigorous work. Commercial effectiveness and integrity in concept and execution are highlighted as core qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judged by the best (jury quality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Judged by the best, a Pencil is a recognition, a career shifter, and a green-eyed provoking inspiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The calibre of the jury is part of the award's value; entrants should expect assessment by senior, respected practitioners and frame submissions accordingly (professional presentation, clarity of idea, evidence of impact).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reassuringly difficult / high bar
rubrics_metrics.description: We famously set the bar high, so that your award means something. We’re not mean, just unerringly focused on driving excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should be exceptional; mediocrity will not be rewarded. The programme emphasises strict standards intended to preserve prestige.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Entered by almost 90 countries, a win marks your position on the global stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that can stand up internationally and be relevant across markets will be valued. Winning is positioned as proof of global standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-defining impact
rubrics_metrics.description: A Pencil earns you lasting respect from employers and your peers. It can help swing an interview, a pitch, and even the odd invite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should consider how the work demonstrates professional competence and potential to shift career trajectories — present outcomes and context that highlight career value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative connecting / community benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: Winners join the trusted D&AD community for support and advice, and to make work that pushes our craft forwards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D&AD values community-building; entries that show collaborative practice, mentorship, or contributions to the craft may align with this value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not-for-profit / support for future generations
rubrics_metrics.description: Not for profit — Enter and support future generations. All our surplus is reinvested into education and development programmes such as Shift and New Blood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The awards frame entry as contributing to education and development; applicants (especially agencies/companies) may highlight educational or developmental outcomes connected to the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Blood Awards — student and starter focus
rubrics_metrics.description: New Blood Awards – for students and starters. Launch your career in advertising and design with an award for students, graduates and aspiring creatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a distinct track aimed at emerging talent; student entries should emphasise potential, learning, originality, and readiness to transition into professional practice.
